title: Predictive Atom 5 (PA5): Decision-Certified Key-Value Cache Retrieval for Efficient AI Inference
description: Preliminary AI-assisted research by Zakk Easterbrook on progressive key-value cache retrieval with deterministic real-arithmetic error bounds for a single attention operation and a bias-free linear readout. Includes source code, mathematical proof, original synthetic CPU benchmarks and raw trial data, exact-rational tests, and a post-publication numerical erratum documenting an original float64 counterexample and an optional range-screened mitigation. Not peer-reviewed; no universal finite-precision, full-transformer, GPU, or state-of-the-art performance claim.
